claims.object_text: nuclear protein with a transcriptional repressor role that recognizes DNA methylation marks
claims.quote: Methyl CpG binding protein 2 (MeCP2) was first identified as a nuclear protein with a transcriptional repressor role that recognizes DNA methylation marks.
MeCP2 has a well-established function in neurodevelopment

MeCP2 has a well-established function in neurodevelopment, as evidenced by the severe neurological impairments characteristic of the Rett syndrome (RTT) pathology and the MeCP2 duplication syndrome (MDS), caused by loss or gain of MeCP2 function, respectively.
